purpose: Provide the single parent-owned intake and admission path for typed service responses from Prose, Book Evaluator, Research/Evidence, and Document/Export providers. Preserve exact provider/projection identity and non-success states; deduplicate replay; create immutable parent integration-proposal snapshots; route author-required outcomes without fabricating approval; and prohibit any provider response from directly mutating canonical book pointers or lifecycle state.

immutable_proposal_snapshot.version_rule: Every admission-state change creates a new immutable proposal snapshot with the same proposal_family_id, incremented proposal_version, predecessor_proposal_id bound, and a new proposal_id. Existing parent proposal objects are never updated in place.

intake_rules: The original registered service request and response are both required for intake.
Request/response service, operation, request_id, correlation_id and idempotency_key must match exactly.
Provider class must match the registered service provider_class.
Provider subject SHA and implementation/artifact identity are required and preserved.
Response parent_projection_identity must exactly match the service request parent_state_version/digest.

A response bound to a parent projection older or different from current parent state is preserved as STALE_REJECTED_PRESERVED and cannot create or advance an integration proposal until explicitly revalidated.
Provider-supplied admission_state, canonical_write, canonical pointer, lifecycle transition, author approval or publication authority claims are forbidden input and fail closed.
SUCCESS is not admission. SUCCESS may produce only a PROPOSED snapshot or evidence-only intake according to the registered operation's requested_parent_action.
PARTIAL, ABSTAIN and ERROR are durably preserved as their own result classes; they may not be normalized to SUCCESS.
ABSTAIN requires at least one abstention reason; ERROR requires an error code; PARTIAL preserves warnings/limitations.
Disagreement/minority evidence is preserved and may not be dropped as a condition of admission.

parent_registration.rule: The runtime may atomically register a new immutable proposal snapshot in parent integration_proposals and increment parent state_version. It may not advance canonical pointers, project status or unit lifecycle state. Those remain the qualified Lifecycle Transition Engine's responsibility.

EVIDENCE_REVIEWED: all referenced evidence/artifacts required for review are present
rights/privacy boundaries are known and acceptable for the proposed parent use
ABSTAIN and ERROR results cannot advance
PARTIAL may advance only with explicit preserved limitations and parent review classification
PARENT_PREQUALIFIED: proposal source projection has been explicitly revalidated against current parent state
no critical preservation/canon/rights/privacy hard failure remains
required independent evaluation or qualification refs are present when the capability contract requires them
ADMITTED: all required author decisions are explicitly APPROVED when author_decision_required=true
no stale source/evidence/proposal condition is open
admission creates capability eligibility only; it does not promote a manuscript candidate or advance lifecycle status

author_handoff.trigger: response requested_parent_action=QUEUE_AUTHOR_DECISION or proposal author_decision_required=true before ADMITTED
author_handoff.rule: The integration runtime may queue a decision requirement but cannot populate author_choice, mark it approved, or manufacture a corresponding AUTHOR_DECISION object.

staleness_and_invalidation.parent_state_change: Any proposal snapshot whose last_revalidated_parent_state_version/digest does not match current parent state becomes STALE_FOR_ADMISSION until explicitly revalidated.
staleness_and_invalidation.rights_privacy_change: Affected intake/proposals become STALE_FOR_ADMISSION or REJECTED according to the new boundary; previous evidence is retained.
staleness_and_invalidation.provider_subject_change: New provider output requires new intake identity; prior provider success cannot be silently rebound to a new subject SHA.
staleness_and_invalidation.revalidation: Revalidation is parent-owned and creates a new immutable proposal snapshot; it never edits the old snapshot.

proposal_capability_mapping.rule: capability_id must be a parent-recognized bounded capability or gate token derived from the registered operation, never a provider-defined canonical authority claim.

transactionality.intake_commit: Intake ledger update plus any new parent PROPOSED integration-proposal registration commit atomically as one logical transaction; on failure neither is committed.
transactionality.admission_commit: New proposal snapshot plus parent registration plus ledger receipt commit atomically; on failure prior snapshot remains current and no partial state is exposed.

qualification_objective: Prove all four service families enter one parent-safe intake path; exact request/response/provider/projection validation; provider canonical/admission claim rejection; SUCCESS-not-admission; durable PARTIAL/ABSTAIN/ERROR/disagreement preservation; stale-response preservation without proposal creation; deterministic dedup; immutable proposal versioning; parent-only admission transitions; author handoff without fabricated approval; stale-proposal revalidation; atomic parent/ledger commits; rollback identity; and no direct provider-to-canon or provider-to-lifecycle path.
qualification_effect: NONE until executable implementation and adversarial fixtures pass a registered exact-SHA A-01 qualification.
